findings.key_quote: Years ended September 27, 2025 September 28, 2024... Net income 112,010 93,736... Cash generated by operating activities 111,482 118,254
findings.justification: E2 shows for fiscal 2025 (year ended September 27, 2025): Net income was $112,010M vs $93,736M in FY2024 (an increase of $18,274M or 19.5%). Operating cash flow was $111,482M vs $118,254M in FY2024 (a decrease of $6,772M or -5.7%). The ratio of operating cash flow to net income in FY2025 was 111,482/112,010 = 0.995 (99.5%), compared to 118,254/93,736 = 1.261 (126.1%) in FY2024. This shows cash generation deteriorated relative to net income, not improved. E10 confirms the FY2025 operating cash flow figure of $111,482M.

E12 is a derived metric showing operating cash flow for FY2025 was $111.482B vs $118.254B in FY2024, representing a decline of -5.73%. Combined with E2's net income data showing net income increased from $93.736B to $112.010B (up 19.5%), this demonstrates that cash generation declined while net income improved, meaning cash generation worsened relative to net income, contradicting the claim of improvement.

E16 shows operating cash flow year-over-year growth for FY2025 was -5.73% ($111.482B vs $118.254B). This negative growth in operating cash flow, when compared to the positive growth in net income shown in E2 (19.5% increase from $93.736B to $112.010B), demonstrates that cash generation declined relative to net income improvement, contradicting the assertion.
